name: Relevance
description: Measures how relevant the response is to the given context and the preceding conversation.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how well the response keeps the conversation engaging and interesting.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not engaging at all and 5 is highly engaging

name: Naturalness
description: Assesses how natural and fluent the response sounds in the context of the conversation.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is very unnatural and 5 is very natural

name: Information Content
description: Measures the amount of new and interesting information provided in the response.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is no new information and 5 is a lot of new and interesting information

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and coherence of the response within the conversation.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is incoherent and 5 is highly coherent
